meta.title: Delete your data
meta.description: Request deletion of the data associated with your nisd2.eu account. We handle your request under the GDPR.

dataDeletion.title: Request deletion of your data
dataDeletion.verifiedIntro: Request deletion of the data associated with {email}?
dataDeletion.publicIntro: Enter the email address you registered with. We will check the request and follow up.
dataDeletion.feedbackLabel: What were you looking for? Anything we could have done better? (optional)

confirm.title: Thanks. Your request is recorded.
confirm.body: Under the GDPR we will delete your data, usually within days and at most within one month. You will get a confirmation once it is done.

alreadyDone.title: Nothing to delete
alreadyDone.body: This account has already been removed. There is no data left to delete.

dataDeletion.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
